# agentmail Provider

Terraform provider for [AgentMail](https://agentmail.to). It authenticates with an AgentMail API key, which may be ephemeral, such as one read from a secret store with an ephemeral resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    agentmail = {
      source = "langri-sha/agentmail"
    }
  }
}

# Reads the API key from AGENTMAIL_API_KEY.
provider "agentmail" {}

# Or pass it in, for example from a secret store, and use the EU API.
provider "agentmail" {
  alias    = "eu"
  api_key  = var.agentmail_api_key
  base_url = "https://api.agentmail.eu"
}

variable "agentmail_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) AgentMail API key. Defaults to the `AGENTMAIL_API_KEY` environment variable. The key's scope and permissions bound what the provider can manage.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the AgentMail API. Defaults to `https://api.agentmail.to`; use `https://api.agentmail.eu` for the EU.
